name: AIToolly

sources.title: AIToolly - Submit your product (paid listing form, Stripe checkout)

requirements: NO FREE ROUTE observed: the submit form offers only two paid packages - 'Listing' $29.99 (marked down from $49.99) or 'Listing + Video' $49.99 (from $69.99), paid via Stripe Checkout
This contradicts the launchdesk catalog note 'pricing=free' - the live form has no free option

Required fields: tool name, category (dropdown), product URL, pricing status ('No public pricing / Free only / Free trial / Freemium / Paid only' - required, published verbatim; AIToolly 'does not infer missing prices automatically')
Optional: product brief (English, max 2,000 chars - may be published on the English product page alongside AIToolly's own source-checked content), up to 8 suggested keywords
preparation: Tool name, product URL, and the correct category (their hint: AI APIs/model routers/SDKs go to 'Code & IT'; task/workflow tools usually to 'Productivity')
The product's current pricing status - required and published from your answer
An English product brief <=2,000 chars written for publication (your wording may appear on the product page)
Up to 8 keyword suggestions, comma- or newline-separated
For the +Video package: an English launch video to add after publication
workflow: Open https://aitoolly.com/submit and pick a package: Listing $29.99 or Listing + Video $49.99
Enter tool name, choose category, paste product URL
Fill the 'Editorial context' section in English (optional brief <=2,000 chars)
Select the required pricing status and add up to 8 optional keyword suggestions
Click 'Continue to payment' - one-time payment, final amount reviewed in Stripe Checkout
Package includes 'priority review by the next business day', a permanent product page, 7 days of featured placement, and Domain Search access
watchFor: Everything on this route is paid - no free or badge-gated tier exists on the form
Pricing status is a required published field; you cannot leave it blank or have it inferred
Your brief/keywords 'may appear' verbatim on the English page - write for publication, not for the editor
Delivery target stated as 1 business day; 'priority review' implies editorial review still applies
Sponsor banners and partner links surround the form - ignore upsells
countsAsLive: A permanent AIToolly product page exists for the tool (plus 7-day featured placement) after payment and review
unknowns: Whether any free listing path exists elsewhere on the site (none found on submit or pricing pages)
Whether rejection after payment is possible and what the refund terms are
Whether the product-page outbound link is dofollow
